{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping row with highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 2: Inspect assay_batch values to verify the unit error
# Check batch A and batch B values separately
batch_a_values = df_dedup[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'A']['biomarker_final']
batch_b_values = df_dedup[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final']

print(f'Batch A: min={batch_a_values.min():.2f}, max={batch_a_values.max():.2f}, mean={batch_a_values.mean():.2f}')
print(f'Batch B: min={batch_b_values.min():.2f}, max={batch_b_values.max():.2f}, mean={batch_b_values.mean():.2f}')

# Check if batch B values are approximately 10× larger than batch A
# If so, this confirms the unit error
print(f'Batch B mean / Batch A mean: {batch_b_values.mean() / batch_a_values.mean():.2f}')"}
